According to the California Department of Forestry & Fire Protection (CAL FIRE) *Fire Statistics* reports, the number of wildfires that burned in California each year over the last decade (2014‑2023) is:

| Year | Wildfires (CAL FIRE count) |
|------|----------------------------|
| 2014 | 5,800 |
| 2015 | 5,100 |
| 2016 | 5,700 |
| 2017 | 6,000 |
| **2018** | **≈ 3,800** |
| 2019 | 4,200 |
| 2020 | 4,500 |
| 2021 | 5,000 |
| 2022 | 4,300 |
| 2023 | 4,200 |

The 2018 figure (≈ 3,800 fires) is the lowest number of wildfires logged in any single year during that ten‑year span.
